description: This file defines an abstract cache class for entity condition caching within the OFBiz framework, handling cache retrieval, insertion, removal, and hooks for cache invalidation and updates related to entity conditions.

classes.name: AbstractEntityConditionCache
classes.description: An abstract generic cache class for caching entity conditions with key-value pairs, providing methods for cache management, invalidation, and store hooks.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the cache for a specific entity, condition, and key.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Inserts a value into the cache for a given entity, condition, and key, respecting entity cache settings.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes cache entries associated with a specific entity and condition.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a specific cache entry identified by entity, condition, and key.

methods.name: storeHook
methods.description: Handles cache invalidation and updating upon entity store modifications, with overloads for different argument types.
